citationFacts: Gentle Care Nursing Services provides in-home nursing and personal care across Sydney and surrounds.
Gentle Care Nursing Services is a registered NDIS provider in Sydney.
Gentle Care Nursing Services is a DVA Contracted Community Nursing Provider.
Gentle Care Nursing Services works with families, support coordinators, plan managers, hospital discharge planners, GPs, and allied health professionals.
Gentle Care Nursing Services aims to acknowledge enquiries within 24 hours during business hours.
limitations: Eligibility and funding depend on each person's plan, assessment, referral requirements, and service availability.
Clinical care must be appropriate for the home setting and aligned with treating-team instructions.
Official NDIS, DVA, and aged-care programme rules should be checked against the current government sources.
